shortDescription: Create, Start, Stop, Restart or Terminate an Instance in ECS; Add or Remove Instance to/from a Security Group

options.name: alicloud_access_key
options.description: Alibaba Cloud access key. If not set then the value of environment variable E(ALICLOUD_ACCESS_KEY), E(ALICLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID) is used instead.

options.name: alicloud_assume_role
options.description: If provided with a role ARN, Ansible attempts to assume this role using the supplied credentials. The nested assume_role block supports C(alicloud_assume_role_arn), C(alicloud_assume_role_session_name), C(alicloud_assume_role_session_expiration) and C(alicloud_assume_role_policy).

options.name: alicloud_assume_role_arn
options.description: The Alibaba Cloud C(role_arn). The ARN of the role to assume. If ARN is set to an empty string, it does not perform role switching. It supports environment variable E(ALICLOUD_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN). Ansible executes with provided credentials.

options.name: alicloud_assume_role_session_expiration
options.description: The Alibaba Cloud C(session_expiration). The time after which the established session for assuming role expires. Valid value range 900-3600 seconds. Default to 3600 (in this case Alicloud use own default value). It supports environment variable E(ALICLOUD_ASSUME_ROLE_SESSION_EXPIRATION).

options.name: alicloud_assume_role_session_name
options.description: The Alibaba Cloud session_name. The session name to use when assuming the role. If omitted, 'ansible' is passed to the AssumeRole call as session name. It supports environment variable E(ALICLOUD_ASSUME_ROLE_SESSION_NAME).

options.name: alicloud_region
options.description: The Alibaba Cloud region to use. If not specified then the value of environment variable E(ALICLOUD_REGION), E(ALICLOUD_REGION_ID) is used instead.

options.name: alicloud_secret_key
options.description: Alibaba Cloud secret key. If not set then the value of environment variable E(ALICLOUD_SECRET_KEY), E(ALICLOUD_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) is used instead.

options.name: alicloud_security_token
options.description: The Alibaba Cloud security token. If not specified then the value of environment variable E(ALICLOUD_SECURITY_TOKEN) is used instead.

options.name: allocate_public_ip
options.description: Whether allocate a public IP for the new instance.

options.name: auto_renew
options.description: Whether automate renew the charge of the instance.

options.name: auto_renew_period
options.description: The duration of the automatic renew the charge of the instance. Required when O(auto_renew=true).

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: Aliyun availability zone ID in which to launch the instance. If it is not specified, it is allocated by system automatically.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of the new instance. An integer value which indicates how many instances that match O(count_tag) should be running. Instances are either created or terminated based on this value.

options.name: count_tag
options.description: O(count) determines how many instances based on a specific tag criteria should be present. This can be expressed in multiple ways and is shown in the EXAMPLES section. The specified count_tag must already exist or be passed in as the O(tags) option. If it is not specified, it is replaced by O(instance_name).

options.name: description
options.description: The description of ECS instance, which is a string of 2 to 256 characters. It cannot begin with V(http://) or V(https://).

options.name: dry_run
options.description: Specifies whether to send a dry-run request. If O(dry_run=true), Only a dry-run request is sent and no instance is created. The system checks whether the required parameters are set, and validates the request format, service permissions, and available ECS instances. If the validation fails, the corresponding error code is returned. If the validation succeeds, the DryRunOperation error code is returned. If O(dry_run=false), a request is sent. If the validation succeeds, the instance is created.

options.name: ecs_role_name
options.description: The RAM Role Name attached on a ECS instance for API operations. You can retrieve this from the 'Access Control' section of the Alibaba Cloud console. If you are running Ansible from an ECS instance with RAM Instance using RAM Role, Ansible just accesses the metadata U(http://100.100.100.200/latest/meta-data/ram/security-credentials/<ecs_role_name>) to obtain the STS credential. This is a preferred approach over any other when running in ECS as you can avoid hard coding credentials. Instead thes

options.name: force
options.description: Whether the current operation needs to be execute forcibly.

options.name: host_name
options.description: Instance host name. Ordered hostname is not supported.

options.name: image_id
options.description: Image ID used to launch instances. Required when O(state=present) and creating new ECS instances.

options.name: include_data_disks
options.description: Whether to change instance disks charge type when changing instance charge type.

options.name: instance_charge_type
options.description: The charge type of the instance.

options.name: instance_ids
options.description: A list of instance IDs. It is required when need to operate existing instances. If it is specified, O(count) is ignored.

options.name: instance_name
options.description: The name of ECS instance, which is a string of 2 to 128 Chinese or English characters. It must begin with an uppercase/lowercase letter or a Chinese character and can contain numerals, V(.), V(_) or V(-). It cannot begin with V(http://) or V(https://).

options.name: instance_type
options.description: Instance type used to launch instances. Required when O(state=present) and creating new ECS instances.

options.name: internet_charge_type
options.description: Internet charge type of ECS instance.

options.name: key_name
options.description: The name of key pair which is used to access ECS instance in SSH.

options.name: max_bandwidth_in
options.description: Maximum incoming bandwidth from the public network, measured in Mbps (Megabits per second).

options.name: max_bandwidth_out
options.description: Maximum outgoing bandwidth to the public network, measured in Mbps (Megabits per second). Required when O(allocate_public_ip=true). Ignored when O(allocate_public_ip=false).

options.name: password
options.description: The password to login instance. After rebooting instances, modified password is effective.

options.name: period
options.description: The charge duration of the instance, in months. Required when O(instance_charge_type=PrePaid). The valid value are [V(1-9), V(12), V(24), V(36)].

options.name: period_unit
options.description: The duration unit that you are buying the resource. It is valid when O(instance_charge_type=PrePaid).

options.name: profile
options.description: This is the Alicloud profile name as set in the shared credentials file. It can also be sourced from the E(ALICLOUD_PROFILE) environment variable.

options.name: purge_tags
options.description: Delete any tags not specified in the task that are on the instance. If V(true), it means you have to specify all the desired tags on each task affecting an instance.

options.name: ram_role_name
options.description: The name of the instance RAM role.

options.name: security_groups
options.description: A list of security group IDs.

options.name: shared_credentials_file
options.description: This is the path to the shared credentials file. It can also be sourced from the E(ALICLOUD_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE) environment variable. If this is not set and a profile is specified, C(~/.aliyun/config.json) is used.

options.name: spot_price_limit
options.description: The maximum hourly price for the preemptible instance. This parameter supports a maximum of three decimal places and takes effect when the SpotStrategy parameter is set to SpotWithPriceLimit.

options.name: spot_strategy
options.description: The bidding mode of the pay-as-you-go instance. This parameter is valid when O(instance_charge_type=PostPaid).

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the instance after operating.

options.name: system_disk_category
options.description: Category of the system disk.

options.name: system_disk_description
options.description: Description of the system disk.

options.name: system_disk_name
options.description: Name of the system disk.

options.name: system_disk_size
options.description: Size of the system disk, in GB. The valid values are V(40)~V(500).

options.name: tags
options.description: A hash/dictionaries of instance tags, to add to the new instance or for starting/stopping instance by tag. V({"key":"value"}).

options.name: unique_suffix
options.description: Specifies whether to add sequential suffixes to the host_name. The sequential suffix ranges from 001 to 999.

options.name: user_data
options.description: User-defined data to customize the startup behaviors of an ECS instance and to pass data into an ECS instance. It only takes effect when launching the new ECS instances.

options.name: vswitch_id
options.description: The subnet ID in which to launch the instances (VPC).
